limitations: Arm timings are observed on GitHub; adding shared setup yields accounting estimates, not two independently observed standalone PR latencies.
Smart-only Action acquisition/post-action cleanup lies outside the arm timer and cannot improve its negative comparison.
Disk caches were warm but filesystem memory caches reset; this differs from an ordinary restore leaving pages warm.
A common image was pulled once before both arms; its full cost is charged once per joint job.
Four repetitions of one passing refactor are not a representative change distribution; no observed failures means recall cannot be estimated.
Fresh seed includes shared native cache creation and Smart-only enrollment; without a matched native-only seed their incremental costs cannot be separated exactly.
Base did not evolve; lifecycle amortization and refresh costs are unmeasured.
Runner-seconds and payload bytes are not a dollar billing measurement.
